Messages.Author: Kiddo
Messages.Body:
If a non-titled vampire has access to additional votes (via Kduva's Mask, for example), does he get fewer votes when trying to remove a Fee Stake?
Or, to be more precise, does a non-titled vampire with access to perma votes become a titled vampire? Or is it handled just as if he played a Bewitching Oration?

> Kduva's Mask
> Type: Equipment
> Requires: laibon
> Cost: 2 pool
> Unique equipment. Requires a ready Laibon.
> This Laibon gets +1 bleed and 2 additional votes. Reaction cards that require Auspex [aus] cost an additional blood while this Laibon is acting.
>
> Fee Stake: Whatever
> ...
> Any vampire can call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action. In that referendum, non-anarch titles are worth 1 fewer votes.
>

Messages.Author: Chaitan
Messages.Body:
LSJ answer in this thread.

Additional votes does not make a vampire titled so the Fee Stake vote reduction does not effect Kduva's Mask.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
"... has X votes" = TITLE
"... has X additional votes" = not a title

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
